name: gan_p1
hypothesis: GAN probe 1 (5 min, s3d_v1): fine-tune the promoted v1 regression net (init) with conditional patch D (spatial, 32 wide, SN, hinge) + temporal D on 3 unwarped frames + feature matching, small weights (adv 0.01, temporal 0.01, fm 0.1) on top of the unchanged regression losses. The 1.5-min smoke test at 0.05/0.05/0.5 drove hold-out l1 to 1.17x lr and ms_dssim to 1.27x lr (fails the gates) while spectrum fell 0.225 -> 0.126. Expect: spectrum below the init's 0.225 with l1/ms_dssim still under lr on the hold-out.
